selection.sampling: seeded round robin over scene/camera/category/gap/motion/area/displacement/ego strata; descriptive selected cohort, not population estimate
selection.speed_timebase: sample annotation-center displacement / sample timestamp gap

numeric.fixed_position_selection: Predeclared uniform patch-center sample; excludes padded-content centers. This is an image-coordinate diagnostic.
numeric.negative_control: Same scene, camera and exact target frame; different official instance; target area/depth ratios bounded; controls may be reused across anchors

uncertainty: Bootstrap scene-equal means, not independent objects/frames. A single-scene CI is unavailable. Quantiles and AUC are descriptive. Condition associations are not causal.
hypothesis_status: Use observed distances together with repeated-input control and matched negative baselines; no universal invariance/caching threshold
